verdict.rationale: Statsig documents randomized controlled trials that report metric lifts with confidence intervals, and offers variance-reduction and measurement tools including CUPED and stratified sampling. A community practitioner also praises its statistical rigor. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the statistical methodology (frequentist vs Bayesian choice, sequential testing, multiple-comparison handling), confirmation that CUPED applies outside the Warehouse Native context, and independent hands-on validation of the engine.
